info.name: HashiCorp Consul HTTP Agent API
info.description:
The Consul HTTP API provides full access to Consul functionality including service discovery, health checking, key/value storage, ACL management, Connect service mesh, configuration entries, and multi-datacenter operations.

Contact Support:
 Name: HashiCorp
